description: Change history for a tracked app — detected releases, metadata edits, screenshot swaps, price changes, and category moves, newest first. Useful for correlating rank movements with what the app (or a competitor) changed. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts).

app_id.description: Sonar app UUID — the `id` returned by sonar_list_apps or sonar_create_product. NOT a store id.

type.description: Filter to one change type. Omit for all types.

name: sonar_app_changes
title: App Change History
